profile.name: XIA xMAP多通道数字脉冲处理器
profile.name_en: XIA xMAP Multi-Channel Digital Pulse Processor
profile.description: 这是一种用于辐射探测器读出的多通道数字脉冲处理与多道分析电子学设备，可采集能谱、进行ROI区域统计、执行逐像素mapping，并将测量数据保存为文件。常用于X射线荧光、能谱分析及同步扫描实验。
profile.description_en: This is a multi-channel digital pulse processing and multichannel analysis instrument for radiation detector readout. It acquires spectra, performs ROI-based counting, supports pixel-by-pixel mapping, and saves measurement data to files. It is commonly used for X-ray fluorescence, spectral analysis, and scanning experiments.
